stage_validation.policy: Trace coverage is converted from epoch to monotonic using the recording offset; phase state comes only from stage-events/current evidence.

full_toc_stage_validation.policy: Trace coverage is converted from epoch to monotonic using the recording offset; phase state comes only from stage-events/current evidence.

gpu_mps_interpretation: No GPU Active intervals or PyTorchMPS signposts in pose window; treat as CPU model path only if stage evidence confirms pose stage.
